messages:
maria: Heads up — noticed weird quota attribution when delegated SA calls hit edge routing. top-level metrics show quota spent under org default instead of the originating project.
kevin: Repro steps?
maria: Steps: create SA under project A, exchange token for delegated key, call /v1/generate using project-scoped key. Dashboard shows consumption in org default bucket.
anya: that's bad. Is it the exchange path adding org claim? 🤔
kevin: can you paste logs (correlation id)?
maria: pasted — correlation 1788234-req-332
maria: ```json
{"x-auth-origin":"projects/12345/serviceAccounts/delegated-sa","token_claims":{"org":"org-999","project":"proj-123","delegated":true}}
```
sam: hmm token_claims.org present. Router currently prefers org when present. We originally made org > project to handle cross-project admin keys.
anya: do we still need org-first precedence? it breaks per-project quotas and billing for delegated flows.
kevin: we added org-first to avoid double-counting for admin scenarios, but delegated SA is a distinct case. we can bias to project when delegated==true.
maria: proposal: override precedence for delegated tokens: if token_claims.delegated == true, prefer token_claims.project over token_claims.org (unless project is missing). keeps legacy behavior for non-delegated.
sam: +1. also add telemetry so we can see how often fallback to org happens after change.
kevin: router changes are small but need tests. also console should show both attributions and which rule matched so support can debug.
anya: agreed. UI addition: show an "Attribution" chip on the request detail: "Project (delegated-sa override)" or "Org (legacy)". quick and visible.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: auth-router v2.14 -> canary roll 3 nodes @ 02:30 UTC
maria: test checklist: 1) create SA under project B 2) exchange token 3) call endpoints 4) confirm quota uses proj B 5) check console activity log shows rule match
sam: i'll own telemetry + dashboard patch. kevin -> router change? can you add unit tests for claim precedence and an integration test exercise?
kevin: yep. i'll open a PR today, tag @sam @anya. will include e2e that simulates token exchange.
anya: add alert if >1% of delegated calls still attributed to org after rollout.
maria: thanks all :thumbsup:
kevin: FYI we'll run canary for 2 hours then ramp if no anomalies.
sam: will add dashboard panel "delegated_sa_attrib_fallback" and wire to SLI. also add a tracer tag: auth.attribution.rule so we can filter traces.
maria: closing loop: filing INF-4827 to track impl + QA + rollout notes.
maria: marking this thread resolved once deploy completes.
